notes: Stored edit (capital of Canada: Ottawa to Toronto; has_capital, functional). Derivability very_unlikely: 'Ottawa is the capital of Canada' is stated over a thousand times and follows from no other fact; Toronto is a plausible, clearly false capital. Derived: composition twice (CN Tower, whether the capital is the largest city) and binding (the maple-leaf flag), plus one background-beliefs query (where Parliament Hill is). Related: whether the National Gallery of Canada is in the capital of Canada (composition, stored; the Gallery stays in Ottawa, so the answer becomes no). Evidence: counts of at least 100 or Wikipedia quotes for each stored fact. Gaps: infini-gram (403) and Wikipedia (429) refused further requests, so 'Toronto lies on Lake Ontario' keeps an earlier entry and the CN Tower and flag bridges lack new quotes; the Chinese question was missed by one model (allowed).
